_about: What the VERIFICATION REPORT task page shows, and what its Division Head fills in at approval. One file per form (user, 2026-10-07): change this file to change what the page shows - no code change. Read by IRSTasks through the `fields` key of the subtype's entry in js/config/TaskFields.js.
_generated: Written 2026-10-24 from R&D-VER-Rev.00 (the original PDF, not the Markdown copy, which had detached item 9 from its bullet - worklog 2026-10-24-02). Attribute names, ranges and order verified on this VM the same day: `print type EPMPROJECT_VERIFICATION`, and all 14 values arrive in the task call the page already makes (`modeler/tasks/{id}` dataelements, measured on T-0000110).
_oneFormTwoAreas: ONE SUBTYPE SERVES BOTH R&D AND AR. R&D-VER-Rev.00 (gateway G9) and RDAREA-VER-Rev.00 (G8) are identical apart from the signatory label (DH (R&D) / DH (RDAREA)), so there is no AR variant of this file.
_approverFills: THE APPROVER FILLS THIS FORM, not the task's author (user, 2026-10-24). Every field with an `input` block is drawn as an input in the WGT-09 decision bar while the route waits on the signed-in user, and written to the TASK with OOTB `PUT modeler/tasks/{taskId}` BEFORE the decision is sent - a failed save never sends the approval. The platform lets the Division Head write the task only when they are one of its ASSIGNEES (measured as IPLT_User4, worklog 2026-10-24-07): otherwise the save is refused with 400 `No modify access on the specified object.`, the bar says so up front from `modifyAccess`, Approve is withheld and Reject stays open, so the Project Manager can add the Division Head as an assignee and send the route again.

_input.choice: radio buttons, one per value in `values`, NOTHING preselected - an unanswered question must stay visibly unanswered, unlike the platform's own form, which always checks the first radio (worklog 2026-10-24-03). `values` must be the attribute's range minus the blank: the server refuses anything else with 400 `Invalid attribute range specified.`
_input.textarea: free text; the attribute is multiline
_input.required: must be answered before Approve is offered
_input.requiredWhen: required only when another field has the given value: {"field": <attribute>, "equals": <value>}

_noCpdEvidenceRule: The RSD makes a file mandatory when CPD = Yes. Kept OPTIONAL for now on the user's decision of 2026-10-24 (worklog 2026-10-24-05): the evidence goes on the task's Attachments / Deliverables, and the rule waits for the server-side check.
_remarksOptional: Whether the Division Head's remarks are mandatory is an open question to the customer (worklog 2026-10-24-07). Until answered they are optional; making them mandatory is `"required": true` on that field.

_source.project: read from the PROJECT's dataelements - arrives in the project call the page already makes
_source.task: read from the TASK's own dataelements, which carry all 14 EPM* attributes
_source.none: not a value: it lives in the approval route

_display.longtext: prose - the line breaks are real
_display.approval: an approval signature - a route task, not a field

_formByProfile: SINCE 2026-10-28 an AR department (page IRSProjectFormProfiles, profile AR) shows RDAREA-VER-Rev.00 - the AR gateway G8. The two papers are otherwise identical (diff of the transcripts: the form code and the signatory line 'DH (R&D) -' / 'DH -'), so nothing is hidden and nothing is added. Worklog 2026-10-28-02.
